title: SpeechEQ: Benchmarking Emotional Intelligence Quotient in Socially Aware Voice Conversational Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.25990v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As multimodal conversational systems increasingly engage in spoken interaction, their ability to navigate paralinguistic social cues has become a critical bottleneck for natural human-AI communication. However, existing evaluations of machine emotional intelligence assess reasoning exclusively through isolated text or passive acoustic perception, overlooking the complex cross-modal reasoning required for active, multi-turn dialogue. We introduce \textsc{SpeechEQ}, a comprehensive framework designed to evaluate the sociolinguistic reasoning of Speech-Language Models (SLMs). The framework includes a validated dataset of 2,265 dialogues across 15 Emotional Quotient (EQ) subscales grounded in EQ-i 2.0 theory, along with a multi-turn evaluation protocol measured by our proposed Spoken EQ (SEQ) score inspired by human EQ assessments. translated_title: SpeechEQ：面向社交感知语音对话模型的情商基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着多模态对话系统日益参与语音交互，其处理副语言社交线索的能力已成为自然人机交流的关键瓶颈。然而，现有的机器情商评估仅通过孤立的文本或被动的声学感知来评估推理能力，忽视了主动的多轮对话所需的复杂跨模态推理。我们提出了SpeechEQ，这是一个旨在评估语音语言模型社交语言推理能力的综合框架。该框架包含一个经过验证的数据集，涵盖2,265段对话，并基于EQ-i 2.0理论划分为15个情商（EQ）子量表，同时提出了一套多轮评估协议，通过受人类情商评估启发的口语情商（SEQ）分数进行衡量。实验表明，无论是现有的语音情感识别方法还是端到端的语音语言模型，在应对此类任务时均存在局限性。
tldr: 提出了SpeechEQ评估框架，基于EQ-i 2.0理论构建了包含2,265段对话、覆盖15个情商子量表的数据集，并设计了口语情商（SEQ）评分，用于系统评估语音语言模型在多轮语音对话中的社交情感推理能力。
en_tdlr: SpeechEQ is a comprehensive benchmark featuring a validated dataset of 2,265 dialogues across 15 EQ-i 2.0-based subscales and a proposed Spoken EQ (SEQ) score to evaluate the sociolinguistic and emotional reasoning of Speech-Language Models in active multi-turn spoken dialogue.
